Python is a high-level programming language known for readable syntax, used in web apps, data, and AI.
Artificial intelligence is software that performs tasks that usually need human judgment — classifying, generating, or deciding from data.
Machine learning is a type of AI where models learn patterns from examples instead of only hard-coded rules.
NLP (natural language processing) is how software reads, classifies, and generates human language.
OCR (optical character recognition) turns text inside an image into editable characters. SnapCut’s Image to Text tool does this.
At standard pressure, water boils at 100°C / 212°F.
The speed of light in vacuum is about 299,792 km per second.
Earth takes about 365.25 days to orbit the Sun.
Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
SnapCut AI is a workspace for Remove Text, Image to Text, Collage Maker, and Snapy image generation.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Photosynthesis is how plants turn light, water, and carbon dioxide into sugar and oxygen.
HTTP 404 means the server could not find the requested page.
JSON is a text format for structured data — objects and arrays — used by most web APIs.
An API is a contract that lets one program request data or work from another program.
